## Goal
Create a fresh implementation of the install request issue-template flow from PR #293 on top of the merged first-class `/install` route from PR #298.

## Context
- PR #293, "Add install request issue template", was closed and was originally stacked on older `/install` work.
- PR #298 has now merged the main `/install` route, install-only `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT` execution, typed target resolution, and fork-backed prepare/publish helpers.
- The useful #293 behavior to recreate is the user-facing install request issue template plus source-request linkage/cleanup for issue-backed install runs.
- Prior review on #293 flagged that issue-close/status parsing should avoid brittle inline workflow shell and markdown-wide regex parsing. Prefer the existing typed helper/CLI style introduced by #298.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add or restore a simple install request issue template that starts with `@sepo-agent /install` and leaves space for a requester to provide a public target repository URL.
- Update README and install documentation so users can find and use the issue-template install request path.
- For issue-backed install runs, include a reference to the source install request in the target install PR body when a PR is published or reused.
- After a successful published/reused install PR response, close the source install request issue with a concise comment linking the target PR.
- Cleanup/close behavior is idempotent and non-fatal if source issue closure fails after the install PR has already been created or reused.
- Any status parsing or PR URL extraction is structured and tested, preferably through typed `.agent/src` helper/CLI code rather than substantial inline workflow shell.
- Add focused tests for the issue-backed install request lifecycle and run the relevant build/test checks.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/293
